structure_steps: Diffusion steps for the initial volume. Zero uses the profile. More steps increase computation without guaranteeing a better model.
structure_guidance: How strongly the initial volume follows the reference image. Excessive guidance can distort the result.
structure_rescale: Regulates the amplitude of volume guidance. Higher values can change detail while reducing excessive guidance.
structure_rescale_t: Changes the timing distribution of volume diffusion steps without increasing their count.
shape_steps: Steps per geometry generation pass. Zero uses the profile. More steps take longer.
shape_guidance: Reference strength for geometry and surface detail. Excessive guidance may produce bumps or artifacts.
shape_rescale: Regulates geometry guidance when its strength is high.
shape_rescale_t: Redistributes geometry diffusion steps over time; the step count remains unchanged.
texture_steps: Material generation steps. Zero uses the profile. More steps may add detail but take longer.
texture_guidance: Reference strength for colour and materials. Excessive guidance may amplify defects or contrast.
texture_rescale: Regulates material guidance when texture guidance is high.
texture_rescale_t: Redistributes texture diffusion steps over time without increasing their count.
texture_seed: Separate random seed for materials. Minus one continues the main random sequence; a fixed seed helps compare material settings.
mesh_mode: Remesh rebuilds a surface then simplifies it and may soften detail. Direct simplifies the generated surface while keeping more irregularities.
pre_simplify: First reduces dense surfaces towards two million triangles to limit processing cost. Disable to retain the raw surface for finishing.
repair_holes: Fills small openings before surface reconstruction. Enabled by profile D; it does not guarantee a closed mesh or preservation of every thin detail.
remesh_project: Projects the rebuilt surface towards the source. Zero keeps the reconstruction; one applies maximum projection. Used with remeshing only.
remesh_band: Width of the reconstruction band in voxels. This can affect thin parts and processing cost.
qem_edge_weight: Edge-length penalty during simplification. Higher values favour a more regular triangle distribution. Zero prioritises shape error and can create elongated triangles.
qem_skinny_weight: Penalises simplifications that produce very thin triangles while keeping the target triangle count.
uv_angle: Face grouping angle in degrees. Smaller values create more UV islands; larger values group more broadly and can affect stretching.
uv_refine: Iterations to refine UV groups before unwrapping. Zero disables refinement; higher values take longer and may change islands.
uv_global: Global grouping passes before UV unwrapping. More passes take longer and can reorganise islands.
uv_smooth: Smoothing strength for grouping faces into UV regions. Changes island boundaries without smoothing model geometry.
